description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeCsvImportSampleAttachmentController class, which extends an abstract file controller. The handle method generates a CSV header string representing employee data fields and prepares an HTTP response to download this as 'importData.csv'. It appears to serve as a sample or template CSV attachment for employee data import functionality in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeCsvImportSampleAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller class handling the generation and sending of a sample CSV file for employee data import.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request by setting HTTP headers and returning a response containing a CSV header string for employee data.
